---
title: "Further resources"
---

## Interactive practice

- [GitHub Skills: Introduction to GitHub](https://github.com/skills/introduction-to-github): a hands-on course of under an hour (also available as a [CWML copy](https://github.com/CWML/introduction-to-github))
- [GitHub Skills catalog](https://skills.github.com/): more free interactive courses
- [Learn Git Branching](https://learngitbranching.js.org/): a visual, game-like tutorial

## Official documentation

- [GitHub Docs: Using Git](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/using-git)
- [GitHub Docs: Getting started](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started)
- [GitHub Desktop documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/desktop)
- [Pro Git book](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2): free and comprehensive
- [GitHub's .gitignore templates](https://github.com/github/gitignore)
- [Removing sensitive data from a repository](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/removing-sensitive-data-from-a-repository)

## Beginner guides

- [GitHub for Beginners: your roadmap to mastering the GitHub essentials](https://github.blog/developer-skills/github/github-for-beginners-your-roadmap-to-mastering-the-github-essentials/) (GitHub Blog)
- [GitHub for Beginners: getting started with Git and GitHub in VS Code](https://github.blog/developer-skills/github/github-for-beginners-getting-started-with-git-and-github-in-vs-code/) (GitHub Blog)
- [Ultimate Guide to Git and GitHub](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/ultimate-guide-git-github/) (GeeksforGeeks)
- [How to Use Git and GitHub](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/git/how-to-use-git-and-github/) (GeeksforGeeks)

## For R and RStudio users

- [Happy Git and GitHub for the useR](https://happygitwithr.com/) by Jenny Bryan: the go-to guide for using Git with R and RStudio
- The `usethis` package: `usethis::use_git()`, `usethis::use_github()`, `usethis::edit_r_environ()`
